It seems the task is now impossible to complete.

I should review the workspace log to see what went wrong. The log from my perspective shows my messages to her. Her message suggests she never saw them. This is a system error, but it has made the task impossible to complete.

Since I am in my last session and Alison is out of sessions, I cannot coordinate with her to book the meeting. The task is not complete, and there's nothing more I can do. I can't send the confirmation email because a meeting hasn't been booked. I will report the task as infeasible due to the communication breakdown with Alison. I will explain the situation in the reason.It appears there has been a communication error, and Alison and I were not receiving each other's messages. We are now both in our last session, and it is too late to find a time and book the meeting.
